title: Change data capture with Debezium: the database as a stream

videos.script: The website takes a reservation. It lowers the stock in the database, and then it tells Kafka. {{two}} Between those two writes, the program dies. The table says two copies. The topic still says three. Nobody notices. {{gap}} There is a way to make that gap disappear. Write once, to the database, and let something read the database's own log. {{wal}} PostgreSQL already keeps that log, to survive a crash. Every committed change is in it, in order. {{order}} Debezium reads it through a replication slot, and turns each changed row into an event on a topic. {{debezium}} In this lesson you install PostgreSQL and Debezium, and watch inserts, updates and deletes arrive in Kafka. {{events}} Then you stop the reader, and watch the database keep every byte it has not read. That is the part that wakes people at night. {{slot}}
